description: Use when the user wants a guided, step-by-step journey on a topic, a skill or an exam. Searches the published journeys and returns up to three cards (id, title, summary, shape, languages, number of stops, estimated minutes, who it is for and not for, a premium flag, page_url). `in_progress: true` marks a journey this user already has open. When nothing matches, `alternatives` holds the three nearest journeys.

locale.description: The user's locale (en, fr, es, ar).

query.description: The topic, skill or exam to search for, in a few words. The topic only, no personal details.

name: find_journey
title: Find a guided journey
